instructions: Unpack the handoff and the companion CHOS source ZIP. The WebKit JSCOnly source tree is already patched;do not apply its patch again. Original notices/license texts remain with the source.

Run python3 relink.py /path/to/clang++ from the handoff after extraction. It relocates the supplied SDK,ordinary static engine archives,53 separately linked objects and fixture object. The qualified result was independently relinked in a different directory and its stripped executable matched byte for byte.

For modified source,adapt the recorded CMake input paths to the extracted directories. Current configuration files and required options above are authoritative;the initial configure command is historical. Use the CHOS native CMake toolchain and provided native platform files,not a Linux toolchain. Rebuild the modified libraries and replace the corresponding files under engine/lib before relinking.

The exact CHOS source contains SDK dependency sources/licenses,build scripts,pinned Test262 scripts and fixture sources. Full engine/runtime instructions and qualification limits are in docs/NATIVE_JSC_STANDARDS.md. Modified code must be requalified;old successes do not qualify it.
Stage3 full WebCore/browser,wireless and production security acceptance remain incomplete.
